blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated dolphin cruises, Crab Island excursions, fireworks viewing cruises, and dinner cruises aboard luxury yachts. Cruises offer scenic views, wildlife sightings, and special event celebrations such as the 4th of July. Some cruises include meals, live entertainment, and opportunities to see dolphins and fireworks from the water.
extraNote: 4th of July cruise sells out every summer · Dolphin sightings not guaranteed · Docked at the Baytowne Marina inside the Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort for some cruises; Destin Harbor for dolphin cruises.
